---
title: "1. Setup"
---

## GitHub
1. Create an account at <https://github.com>. Students/faculty: apply for [GitHub Education](https://education.github.com) — free Copilot Pro.
2. Send your username to the instructor to be added as a collaborator (or fork the repo).
3. Install Git: macOS `xcode-select --install`; Windows <https://git-scm.com>.
4. Identify yourself once:
```bash
git config --global user.name "Your Name"
git config --global user.email "you@unm.edu"
```
5. Authenticate: install the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com) and run `gh auth login`.

## Copilot
- VS Code → Extensions → **GitHub Copilot** + **Copilot Chat** → sign in.
- RStudio → *Tools → Global Options → Copilot → Enable*.
- Copilot reads `.github/copilot-instructions.md` (here, it points to `AGENTS.md`).

## Claude Code
```bash
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code   # or: brew install claude-code
cd UNM_Workshop && claude
```
Requires a Claude Pro/Max account or API key. VS Code extension: search “Claude Code”.

## No local setup? Use a Codespace
On the repo page: **Code → Codespaces → Create codespace on main**.
The container (`.devcontainer/devcontainer.json`) installs R + tidyverse, RStudio Server (port 8787), Quarto, Copilot, and Claude Code. Free tier: 60 core-hours/month. **Stop your codespace when done.**
